title: One AI Signal, Many Human Judgments: A Bayesian Cascade Analysis of AI-based Credibility Indicators in Online Information Spread
abstract: arXiv:2608.30311v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Social media platforms increasingly use AI-based credibility indicators to help users judge misinformation. Unlike individual human-AI decision-making, these indicators are embedded in information spread: users see both an AI prediction and earlier judgments shaped by the same AI, and their own judgments may then enter the public history. Yet how to analytically characterize this process remains under-explored. We therefore introduce a social-learning lens for this setting by extending the classical Bayesian cascade model with the AI indicator as a shared public signal. The resulting Gateway condition compares the evidence from the AI prediction with users' private impressions. Through this view, we show that AI changes what public history means. Crowd agreement may reflect accumulated independent human evidence, or repeated dependence on the same AI prediction. This creates a preservation-correction trade-off: stronger reliance on AI

translated_title: 一个AI信号，多个人类判断：在线信息传播中基于AI的可信度指标的贝叶斯级联分析
translated_abstract: 社交媒体平台越来越多地使用基于AI的可信度指标来帮助用户判断错误信息。与个体层面的人机决策不同，这些指标嵌入在信息传播过程之中：用户既会看到AI的预测，也会看到受同一AI影响的先前判断，而他们自己的判断随后又可能进入公共历史记录。然而，如何从分析角度刻画这一过程仍缺乏研究。因此，我们为这一情境引入了社会学习的视角，通过将AI指标作为共享公共信号来扩展经典的贝叶斯级联模型。由此得出的“网关条件”将AI预测所提供的证据与用户的私人印象进行比较。通过这一视角，我们表明AI改变了公共历史的含义：群体的一致同意可能反映了积累起来的独立人类证据，也可能反映了对同一AI预测的反复依赖。这产生了一种“保留—纠正”权衡：对AI更强的依赖……
tldr: 该论文将AI可信度指标作为共享公共信号引入经典贝叶斯级联模型，提出“网关条件”分析框架，揭示了AI改变了公共历史的含义——群体共识可能源于独立人类证据的积累，也可能源于对同一AI预测的反复依赖，从而产生“保留—纠正”权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the classical Bayesian cascade model by treating AI-based credibility indicators as a shared public signal, introducing a Gateway condition that reveals AI changes the meaning of public history—crowd agreement may reflect accumulated independent human evidence or repeated dependence on the same AI prediction—creating a preservation-correction trade-off.
